note.text:
Every Create stone family cuts freely between its own variants on a
Stonecutter - andesite, asurine, calcite, crimsite, deepslate, diorite,
dripstone, granite, limestone, ochrum, scoria, scorchia, tuff and
veridium. Put any block of a family in to see all of its variants.
